text.answer: Aurelion Sol is an AP mage whose damaging abilities collect permanent Stardust to strengthen his kit. He channels sustained breath damage, can cast while flying over terrain, and uses a pulling black hole and a crowd-controlling star impact. Break contact with his breath, leave the black hole, and move away from the star's impact area.
text.counterplay: Break contact with his breath, leave the black hole, and move away from the star's impact area.

text.answer: Astral Flight carries Aurelion Sol over terrain while allowing him to cast abilities. During flight, Breath of Light has no cooldown or maximum channel duration and deals increased flat damage, but channeling slows his flight. Immobilizing crowd control interrupts the flight, and a champion takedown soon after he damages them greatly reduces its cooldown.
text.counterplay: Use immobilizing crowd control to contest his flight, and anticipate renewed mobility after a takedown.
